description: Advisories the estate has read, assessed and accepted, with the reason and a date by which each must be looked at again. It exists because the CI audit gate had been failing: 34 high-severity findings, every one transitive through kepler.gl, and a gate that always fails is a gate nobody reads. Lowering the threshold would have made it green and meaningless. This keeps the gate at high, and makes it fail on anything that is not in here.
rules: An advisory not listed here fails the build, whatever its severity relative to the threshold.
A listed advisory past its review date fails the build: an acceptance with no expiry is a permanent exception.
A listed advisory that no longer appears fails the build, so the register cannot accumulate entries that describe nothing.
Reachability is an assessment about this deployment. The dock is a static frontend with no server; if that changes, every unreachable entry here must be reassessed.

accepted.title: d3-color vulnerable to ReDoS
accepted.assessment: ReDoS on a crafted colour string. The dock passes its own palette constants; no colour string in the bundle comes from a user or a fetched document.
accepted.accepted_because: No non-breaking upgrade exists: every path is pinned by kepler.gl, and the available fix is a major bump that would change the Map and Solar lenses.
